race.comment: COLUMBUS (5) dominated his rivals fresh and has been okay in his next two without paying his supporters. The rise to 1800m looks perfect fourth-up. Bold showing anticipated. MAZIS (2) hit the line nicely fresh without threatening the promising Mr Miller. Is sure to have come on from that and is another that will appreciate the rise in trip. FUNCHAL (1) returns. Didn't fire in her only run last time in but has jumped out well in readiness and if Price & Kent Jnr can get her back to her WA form she can have a good prep. MY CHARM (6) made light work of her rivals at Hawkesbury second-up and while this is obviously tougher, she deserves respect with more to offer. Can't knock the form of PIERRO LAD (3) who shoots for four on the bounce. Yet to be tested at this trip though.
